lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Then we starve honestly. Miss Vance, take your case down the mountain.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: You will regret this within the year. Everyone does.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That is the charter I grew up under. Word for word. I always assumed it was written by someone braver than me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vance closes her case without hurrying. Behind her, something tall unfolds itself off the transport and starts up the path.
